tei:div.tei:p: "$ (73)༄༅// byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid gser gyi yang zhun zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

(74)༄༅// rje btsun bla ma skyabs gsum kun 'dus kyi bdag nyid chen po gang de'i zhabs la gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de la 'dir dal 'byor gyi rten la snying bo len bar 'dod pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis nyams su blang bar bya ba ni/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad kyi snying bo// dus gsum 'phags pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ shing rta chen po klu sgrub dang thogs med gnyis kyi lam srol/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sar 'gro ba'i skye bo mchog gi chos lugs/ skyes bu gsum gyis nyams su blang bya'i rim pa thams cad ma tshang ba med pa bsdus pa/ byang chub lam gyi rim bzhes bya ba 'di nyid yin la/ 'di la thog mar nyams su blang bya'i chos khungs btsun khyad par du 'phags pa zhig yin pa dang*// khungs btsun pa nas byung ba'i chos de yang*// phyogs re tsam ma yin pa'i lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs shing cha tshang la ma nor ba zhig dgos pa yin la/ da res bdag gis nyams su blang bya'i lam gyi rim pa 'di ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas bzung klu sgrub thogs med gnyis las rim bzhin brgyud pas khungs btsun pa yin zhing*/ khungs btsun de rnams las brgyud pa'i chos kyi rim pa 'dis skye rgu rnams kyi 'dod don ma lus pa bde blag tu skong pas (75)na rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bu dang*/ theg pa che chung gi gzhung lugs bzang po ma lus pa'i legs bshad kyi chu bo 'du bas na rgya mtsho chen po lta bu dang*/ mdo sngags kyi gnad bsdus nas ston pas brjod bya yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ sems 'dul ba'i rim pa gtso bor byas pas nyams su len bde ba dang*/ klu sgrub kyi lugs la mkhas pa'i rig pa'i khu byug dang*/ thogs med kyi lugs la mkhas pa'i gser gling pa'i gdams pas brgyan pa yin pas 'di lta bu la nyan bsam sgom gsum byed du yong pa ni bdag skal ba bzang la/

rang re'i bla ma'i gsung mgur las kyang*/ 'dzam gling mkhas pa yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan// snyan pa'i ba dan 'gro la lhang nge ba// klu sgrub thogs med gnyis las rim bzhin du// legs brgyud byang chub lam gyi rim pa ni// skye rgu'i 'dod don ma lus skong bas na// gdams pa rin chen dbang gi rgyal po ste// gzhung bzang stong gi chu bo 'dus pa'i phyir// dpal ldan legs par bshad pa'i rgya mtsho'ang yin/ zhes gsungs so// des na gdams pa 'di gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa'i che ba bzhi dang ldan pa yin te/ gdams pa 'di la brten nas rgyal ba'i gsung rab ji snyed pa thams cad las kha cig lam gyi gtso bo// kha cig lam gyi yan lag (76)ston byed du shes nas dngos dang brgyud pa ci rigs pa'i sgo nas gang zag rang nyid lta bu gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i cha rkyen du go bas bstan pa thams cad 'gal med du rtogs pa'i che ba/ mdo sngags kyi gsung rab dang de'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos tshad ldan rnams phyi'i go rgya gcod pa'i bshad chos tsam dang*/ nyams su len rgyu'i snying bo yan lag de rnams las gzhan na yod par 'dzin pa'i log rtog rnams lhag ma med par log nas gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i brjod bya mtha' dag bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas zhi lhag gi bar gyi lam gyi rim par bsdus nas de dag gi gdams pa'i mthil du bzung ste brjod bya'i don gyi dpyad sgom dgos pa la dpyad sgom/ 'jog sgom dgos pa la 'jog sgom byed pa'i nyams len ston pa'i gdams ngag tu go bar 'gyur bas na gsung rab thams cad gdams ngag tu 'char ba'i che ba/ de ltar gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i gzhung che ba rnams gdams pa'i mchog yin yang*/ bdag lta bu'i rgya chen po'i gsung rab kyi don la ma sbyangs pa'i gang zag las dang po pa rnams kyis dam pa'i man ngag la ma brten par gzhung chen mo de dag gi don la thos bsam gyis zhugs kyang dgongs don ji lta ba bzhin mi rnyed pa'am/

rnyed kyang dus rgyun ring zhing tshegs shin tu che ba la ltos dgos/ bla ma dam pa'i man ngag lam sgron ni byang chub lam rim nyid lta bu la brten nas gzhung chen po rnams kyi don tshegs med par rnyed pas na rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bde blag tu rnyed pa'i cho pa/ de ltar rnyed pa'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi bka' thams cad dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs ston bar go bas/ 'ga' zhig 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs ston par bzung nas slob dgos pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig 'tshang rgya ba'i gegs su bzung nas dor byar byed pa (77)chos spong gi las yin pas gdams pa 'di la brten nas sngar bshad pa ltar bstan pa thams cad 'gal med du rtogs pa'i nges pa rnyed pa tsam gyis de lta bu'i chos spang gi nyes spyod chen po rang 'gags su 'gyur ba'i che ba rnams dang ldan pa'i phyir/ de ltar na gsung rab kyi don la dpyod pa'i rnam dpyod dang ldan pa'am/ ldan par 'dod na ni rgya bod kyi mkhas pa'i skye bo skal ldan du mas bsten cing thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i gdams pa mchog tu gyur ba skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa 'dis yid rang dbang med par phrog 'phrog ste nyan bsam sgom pa la 'jug rigs te/ gdams pa de nyid gong du bshad pa ltar gyi che ba bzhi dang ldan pas so// rje bla mas kyang*/ bstan pa thams cad 'gal med rtogs pa dang*// gsung rab ma lus gdams par 'char ba dang*// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bde blag rnyed pa dang*// nyes spyod chen po'i g.yang sa las kyang srung*// de phyir rgya bod mkhas pa'i skye bo ni// skal ldan du mas bsten pa'i gdams pa mchog /skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa yis// yid rab mi 'phrog dpyod ldan su zhig yod/ ces gsungs pas so// de lta bu'i che ba dang ldan pa'i gdams pa rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun gyi snying bo phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa'i tshul 'di yongs su rdzogs pa lta ci smos/

thun re tsam phyin ci ma log par stan cing bshad pa'i phan yon bsams te/ snyon pa dang chos la rim gro bskyed/ bsam sbyor rnam dag gi sgo nas snod ldan gyi gang zag la phyin ci ma log par ston pa las dam chos tshul bzhin bshad pa'i phan yon rlabs chen po sdud pa dang*/ nyan tshul phyin ci ma log par snod kyi skyon gsum spang ba dang 'du shes drug bsten pa sogs kyi sgo nas nyan pa la dam (78)chos thos pa'i phan yon rlabs chen sdud pa de 'byung bar nges pas/ nyan bshad tshul bzhin du byed pa la 'bad par bya rigs shing byed dgos te/ rje bla mas/ gsung rab kun gyi snying bo bsdu ba// tshul 'di thun re stan dang nyan pas kyang*// dam chos 'chad dang thos pa'i phan yon tshogs// rlabs chen sdud par nges pas de don bsam/ zhes gsungs pas so// 'o na de lta bu'i gdams pa tshul bzhin du nyan pa la phan yon rlabs chen 'byung ba de lta na/ gdams pa khyad par can de gang zag ji lta bu zhig las nyan dgos snyam na/ spyir dam pa'i chos mnyan par 'os pa'i bshes gnyen la theg pa che chung dang mdo sngags kyi skabs las bshes gnyen gyi mtshan nyid mi 'dra ba mang du gsungs kyang*/ gdams pa rin po che 'di lta bu'i bka' drin nod pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni mdo sde rgyan las bshad pa ltar la/ dul ba tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ zhi ba ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa/ nye bar zhi ba shes rab gyi bslab pa ste/ bslab pa gsum gyi sgo nas rgyud dul bar byas pa'i rtogs pa'i yon tan dang*/ sde snod gsum la sogs pa mang du thos pa lung gi yon tan dang*/ de kho na nyid rab tu rtogs pa'i shes rab dang ldan pa/ slob ma las yon tan lhag pa ste/ chos smra ba po rang gis thob pa'i yon tan drug dang*/ lam la ji ltar dkri ba'i rim pa la mkhas shing don gdul bya'i rna bar skyel ba'i smra mkhas pa/ rnyed bkur sogs la mi lta bar snying rjes kun nas bslang ste chos ston pas kun slong dag pa brtse ba dang*/

chos bshad pa sogs kyi gzhan don la spro ba'i brtson pa dang bcas pa dang*/ 'chad pa'i dka' spyad dang*/ 'khor gyis log sgrub mi bzod pa'i rtog pa spangs te gzhan (79)rjes su 'dzin pa'i yon tan bzhi dang ldan pa ste chos bcu ldan zhig brten nas theg chen gyi gdams pa dang rjes su bstan pa nod par bya zhing*/ nyan pa po'i gang zag kyang spyir gzu bor gnas pa/ lam yang dag pa de la ltar snang gi rnam dbye 'byed pa'i blo dang ldan pa/ lam yang dag don du gnyer ba gsum/ de'i steng du chos dang chos smra ba la gus pa ste bzhi ldan dgos la/ khyad par lam 'di lta bu la dkri rung ba'i slob ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la chos la don gnyer che ba/ nyan pa'i tshe yid la legs par gtod pa/ chos dang chos smra ba la dad gus che ba/ nyes bshad dor nas legs bshad 'dzin pa'i chos bzhi ldan dang*/ de'i mthun rkyen blo dang ldan pa/ 'gal rkyen 'dir ba gzur gnas te drug ldan du bya dgos pas rang yang lam 'di ston pa po byed 'dod na bshes gnyen gyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la 'bad/ nyan pa'i tshe nyan pa po'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la bslab bo// dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig las gdams ngag skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa tshul bzhin nyan nas nyams su ji ltar len pa'i tshul ni/ dang por gnas yid dang mthun par dkon mchog gi rten bkram/ mchod pa g.yo med par legs par bsham/ stan bde ba la skyil krung bcas bsam pa thag pa nas blo ltos bkal ba'i skyabs 'gro rgyud dang 'dres pa mang du byas/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ zhes sogs kyis sems bskyed/ oṃ swa bhā was chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub pas stong ba'i stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rang la lam 'di ston pa'i bla (80)ma dang dbyer med pa'i bdag gi ston pa la rgya chen spyod brgyud dang zab mo lta brgyud kyi bla mas bskor ba dang*/

de'i mthar phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems nyan thos rang rgyal/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs nas bzhugs par gyur// rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// thugs rjes tshad med 'gro la phyogs bcur gzigs// rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las rgyas mdzad pa'i// dus gsum bla ma 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol// ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/ zhes sogs kyis spyan drangs// khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa/ zhes sogs kyis khrus khang bskyed pa/ khrus gsol ba/ sku dpyi ba/ na bza' dang rgyan 'bul ba/ bdag dang 'grol sogs kyis mchod pa/ tshogs kyi zhing du bzhugs su gsol ba rnams spyod 'jug nas 'byung ba ltar bya/ de nas bsags sbyong gi gnad bsdus pa yan lag bdun pa bya ba ni thog mar/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ zhes sogs dang*// thugs rje chen po bde gshegs rdo rje 'chang*// mchog gzigs te lo pa dang zhes sogs kyis nyams len byin rlabs brgyud pa dang*// byams pa thogs med dbyig gnyen rnam grol sde/ zhes sogs kyis rgya chen spyod brgyud dang*/ yod med phyogs 'jig rgyal sras klu sgrub dang*/ zhes sogs kyis zab mo lta brgyud/ rgyal ba'i mdun na zhes sogs kyis jo bo/ yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhes sogs kyis 'brom/ dmigs med brtse ba'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs/ ces sogs kyis rje dang*/ rlabs chen shes rab bzang po'i lus stobs rgyas/ ces sogs dang*/ rig grol phun tshogs ces sogs dang*/ dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes sogs dang*/ gang la bdag (81)cag rig pa bslab pa dang*/ zhes sogs dang*/ ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che/ zhes sogs dang*/ thabs mkhas thugs rjes shākya'i rigs su 'khrungs/ ces sogs dang*/ ji snyed su dag ces pa nas/ phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi/

zhes pa'i bar bya/ de nas maṇ+ḍal rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba dang*/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs/ zhes pa nas/ sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig /ces pa'i bar dang*/ spyi bshags tshar gsum byas/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni/ zhes pa nas/ byang chub phyir bsngo'o// zhes pa'i bar bya/ de nas lam rim gsol 'debs lam mchog sgo 'byed gdangs yid 'khrul pa dang bcas te gdon/ de nas mchod yul rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs zhes gshegs gsol bya/ thun bzhi'am drug tu nyams su len na thun tha ma la gshegs gsol bya/ de ni bshes gnyen bsten tshul gyi sngon 'gro'o// bsten tshul dngos ni dpyad sgom gyi sgo nas bsgom par bya ste/ de yang bdag gi dpal ldan bla ma 'di rnams dngos grub kyi rtsa ba/ 'di phyi'i legs tshogs thams cad kyi 'byung gnas yin/ sman pa dang nad pa bzhin du bla mas sdug bsngal gyi nad sel bas sku drin che/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da bar 'khor bar gtan 'khyams byas pa bshes gnyen de dang ma mjal ba'am/ mjal kyang de'i bka' bzhin ma bsgrubs pas lan/ da ni ngas bla ma ci mnyes byed dgos/ zas nor gyis 'grangs nas skyid rgyags pa'i skabs su gser sbram lag pas theg tshad byin pa las ltog grir 'chi la khad la zas phor gang ster ba drin che ba bzhin/ nga la ni rim lnga las/ 'di ni rang byung bcom ldan 'das// lhag pa'i lha ni gcig pu nyid// man ngag rab tu ster ba'i phyir// rdo rje slob dpon de bas lhag /ces gsungs pa ltar sangs (82)rgyas rnams las kyang bla ma 'di bka' drin che nges bsam/ sngon bdag cag gi ston pas// skye ba yod na 'chi ba yod// 'gog pa 'di ni bde ba yin/ zhes pa'i tshigs bcad phyed tsam dang*/ tshigs bcad re tsam gsan pa'i bla ma la bka' drin bsabs pa'am/ bla ma de mnyes par bya ba'i phyir gser srang 'bum phrag phul ba dang*/ rgyal bo'i sras dang btsun mo la sogs pa ches phongs pa phul ba/

sku lus la mar me stong btsugs pa sogs lus longs spyod thams cad gtong bar mdzad 'dug /bdag kyang ston pa de'i rjes 'jug yin zhing*/ da lta'i bla ma rnams la chos tshad med pa nyan yod pas bka' drin tshad med ang*/ gal te da lta'i bla ma sku yon che ba yin na bka' drin re tsam 'khur/ de min cir yang mi rtsi ba'i khar/ ngas chos nyan yod zer phar dgyen pa byed par 'dug ste/ de ni ma go ba shin tu che ba yin te/ dper na pha ma la yon tan med kyang drin legs par 'khur dgos shing khur na phan yon dang ma khur na nyes dmigs che ba bzhin du bla ma la'ang che nges pa yin no// da lta nor cung zad re byin pa la yang drin che zer na/ bla mas tshe 'di phyi thams cad kyi bde ba la sbyar ba yin/ legs par brtags na ya gi sangs rgyas byang sems nas khyim pa rnams kyi bar thams cad la bla ma mnyes par byas ma byas kyis skyid sdug gi khyad par mngon du mthong ba dang*// der ma zad bla mas tshe gcig la sangs rgyas la bkod pa yang mang du byung*/ ngas kyang bla ma la mchod pa gsum gyis mnyes par byas nas sangs rgyas myur du 'thob nges/ des na bla ma'i bka' drin ni bsam gyis mi khyab pas bka' drin can gyi bla ma mnyes pa gal che ste/ tshe phyi ma rnams su bshes gnyen dam pa dang mjal zhing rjes su 'dzin pa yang da lta chos 'brel yod pa'i bla ma rnams mnyes par byed pa kho na la rag las pas bshes gnyen bsten tshul ma 'chugs pa gcig mi byed pa'i thabs (83)rang mi 'dug ang*/ mdo bstan bcos thams cad las kyang*/ bla ma rnams mnyes par sgrubs shig ces yang yang gsungs shing*/ de nged rang la mi 'dod gdam khar ma gyod bkal ba ni min/ bsod nams mi 'dod ba ni su yang med/ bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing ni bla ma las lhag pa med par mdo rgyud bstan bcos kun nas gsungs/ mnyes pa sgrub pa'ang bla ma la skyon rtog gi blo yem shor ba'i ci mdzad legs par lta ba'i sgo nas dad pa kha tsam min bar snying khong rus pa'i dkyil nas bsgom ste/

mtshan thos pa'am bla ma de dran pa tsam gyis lus kyi ba spu g.yo// mig nas mchi ma 'dzag pa sogs ma byung gi bar du bsgom/ de yang spyir sems can gang gi skyon pa'ang rtog tu mi rung bar rgyal ba sras bcas kyis gsungs na bla ma la lta ci smos/ skyon yod pa ltar snang yang nga rang snang ba ma dag pa yin/ bla ma la de lta bu'i skyon ga la mnga'/ sngon 'phags pa thogs med kyis byams pa bsgrub pas khyi mo smad khog 'bus gang bar gzigs pa dang*/ nā ro pas til+lo pa nya gson sreg byed par gzigs pa sogs dang*/ yab sras mjal ba'i mdo sogs las sangs rgyas kyis bdud sprul nas sems can gyi don mdzad par yang bshad/ des na bla ma la skyon ga la yod/ sangs rgyas dngos yin nges snyam du bsam/ de lta min par bla ma la skyon rtog gi sgo nas brnyas smad sogs byas na ni gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud dang bla ma lnga bcu pa sogs las sdig pa gang las ches che ba'i sdig pa bshad yod/ des na bdag gis 'brom ston pa'i rnam mthar ltar bla ma mang po tshom tshom du mi 'tshol/ gang la bla ma bcol ba de srog dang bsdos nas ma gus pa'i bsam pa gtan nas ma skyes par byed dgos ang snyam du bsgom mo// rje bla mas kyang*/ da nas 'di phyi'i legs (84)tshogs ji snyed ba'i// rten 'brel legs par 'grigs pa'i rtsa ba ni// lam ston bshes gnyen dam pa 'bad pa yis// bsam dang sbyor bas tshul bzhin bsten pa ru// mthong nas srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bar// bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pas mnyes par bya// rnal 'byor ngas kyang nyams len de ltar byas// thar 'dod khyod kyang de bzhin bskyang 'tshal lo// zhes brtse ba chen pos gdams par mdzad do// 'o na lam ston pa'i bshes gnyen de ltar 'bad pas bsten cing bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pas mnyes par bya dgos na bka' ji ltar bsgrub snyam na/ bshes gnyen des ji ltar gdams pa'i dam pa'i chos tshul bzhin du nyams su blangs te/

rgyu dang 'bras bu'i sgo nas shin tu rnyed dka' zhing*/ rnyed na don che ba'i dal 'byor yid bzhin gyi nor bu las lhag pa 'di don ldan du byed pa las lhag pa'i bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i mchod pa gzhan mi 'dug pas des na sor mo gsum khar bcug nas mi lus lan cig thob pa 'di stong log tu ma song ba zhig ma byas na nga'i snying rul ba dang 'dra/ tshe 'di'i dgra 'dul gnyen skyong gzhan don grub pa zhig dang*/ rnyed bkur sogs don gnyer gyi bsam pas kun nas bslangs te chos 'chad nyan/ bslab pa'i srung sdom sogs chos brgyad dkar nag khra gsum po 'di btsan chod du bzhag nas mi rtag pa bsgom pa sogs kyi kha zhe mthun nges kyi chos shig nyams su ma blangs na 'dun ma nyes tshab gzhan las che/ rten 'di la rang gis rang la mi khrel ba'i chos rnam dag nyams su blangs na ni nam bzhag gtan gyi 'dun ma'i rkang tshugs te legs tshab gzhan las che ba 'dug /des nangs khe chung la nyen che ba'i 'jig rten gyi bya ba snying bo med pa'i sbun pa 'phyar ba 'di las ldog ste/ mi lus 'di don ldan 'chi khar 'gyod mi dgos pa'i snying po (85)lon pa zhig byas/ de yang da lta nyid du byed snyam pa'i sgo nas dal 'byor la snying bo len 'dod skom pas gdungs pa chu don du gnyer ba ltar bsgom par bya zhing*/ rje bla mas kyang*/ dal ba'i rten 'di yid bzhin nor las lhag /'di 'dra rnyed pa da res tsam zhig yin// rnyed dka' 'jig sla nam mkha'i glog dang 'dra// tshul 'di bsam nas 'jig rten bya ba kun// spun pa 'phyar ba bzhin du rtogs gyur nas// nyin mtshan kun tu snying bo len pa dgos/ zhes kyang gsung yod ang snyam du bsam/ 'o na dal 'byor gyi rten la snying bo len dgos na snying bo ji ltar len dgos snyam na 'di la gnyis gsungs pa'i/ dang bo lam spyi'i rnam bzhag bskyed tshul 'di la go ba chags pa shin tu gal che bas cung zad bshad na 'di la skyes bu gsum gyi lam du gsung rab thams cad 'dus pa'i tshul/

skyes bu gsum gyi sgo nas 'khrid pa'i rgyu mtshan bstan pa'o// dang bo ni/ sangs rgyas dang bor thugs bskyed pa bar du tshogs bsags pa tha mar sangs rgyas pa thams cad sems can gyi don/ chos gsungs pa thams cad kyang sems can gyi don kho na yin la/ bsgrub bya sems can gyi don la gnas skabs mngon mtho dang mthar thug nges legs gnyis las/ dang bo sgrub tshul las brtsams te gsung pa thams cad skyes bu chung ngu dngos sam chung ngu dang thun mong pa'i chos skor du 'dus te/ skyes bu chung ngu'i khyad par ni lam sgron las/ gang zhig thabs ni gang dag gis// 'khor ba'i bde ba tsam dag la// rang nyid don du gnyer byed pa// de ni skyes bu tha mar shes/ zhes gsungs pa ltar tshe 'di la ched cher mi byed par phyi mar mtho ris kyi bde ba don du gnyer zhing de'i rgyu nyams su len pa zhig la 'jog /nges legs la 'khor ba las grol ba (86)tsam gyi thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis las/ dang bo sgrub pa las brtsams te gsungs pa thams cad skyes bu 'bring dngos sam de dang thun mong gi chos skor du 'dus te/ lam sgron du srid pa'i bde las rgyab phyogs shing*// sdig pa'i las las bzlog bdag nyid// gang zhig rang zhi tsam don gnyer// skyes bu de ni 'bring zhes bya/ zhes gsungs pa ltar skyes bu 'bring tsam ni/ 'khor ba'i phun tshogs la rgyab kyis phyogs nas 'khor ba spangs pa'i bde ba tsam rang don du 'thob byar byas te de'i phyir du bslab pa gsum nyams su len pa la 'jug pa zhig la 'jog /thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang sgrub pa'i thabs la yang gsang sngags dang phar phyin theg pa gnyis su yod pa/ gnyis ka yang skyes bu chen po'i chos skor du 'dus te/ skyes bu chen po de la lam sgron las/ rang rgyud gtogs pa'i sdug bsngal gyis// gang zhig gzhan gyi sdug bsngal kun// yang dag zad par kun nas 'dod// skyes bu de ni mchog yin no// zhes gsungs pa ltar snying rje chen po'i gzhan dbang du gyur bas sems can gzhan gyi sdug bsngal kun zad par bya ba'i phyir du sangs rgyas thob byar byas te phar phyin drug dang rim gnyis la slob pa zhig la 'jog pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa skyes bu gsum gyi sgo nas 'khrid pa'i rgyu mtshan bstan pa ni de ltar skyes bu gsum du bshad kyang skabs 'dir skyes bu chen po'i lam du 'khrid pa'i yan lag tu 'og ma gnyis kyang 'khyer shes dgos la/

de yang srid pa'i phun tshogs tsam la thob byar byed pa'i skyes bu chung ngu tsam dang*/ 'khor ba las thar ba tsam rang don du thob byar byed pa'i skyes bu 'bring tsam gyi lam du 'khrid pa ma yin gyi// de gnyis dang thun mong ba'i lam 'ga' zhig skyes bu chen po'i lam la 'khrid pa'i sngon 'gror byas nas dngos gzhi skyes bu chen po'i lam du 'khrid pa yin (87)la/ de ltar byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni theg chen du 'jug pa'i sgo ni byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa las gzhan med pas byang chub tu sems bskyed dgos/ de la sngon du sems bskyed kyi phan yon bsam ste spro shugs 'phel ba dgos/ sems bskyed kyi phan yon kyang bsdu na gnas skabs kyi dang mthar thug gi phan yon gnyis las gnas skabs mngon mtho'i bde 'bras kyang sems bskyed la brten nas bde blag tu 'grub pa/ mthar thug thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang yang sems bskyed la brten nas 'byung bas byang chub tu sems bskyed dgos la/ de la yang sems can sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba mi bzod pa'i snying rje chen po sngon du 'gro dgos/ de la yang rang sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba la mi 'dod pa'i blo shugs drag gcig dgos pas thog mar chung ngu'i skabs kyi rang la ngan song gi sdug bsngal gyis mnar tshul bsam nas de las thar 'dod kyi blo dang*/ 'bring gi skabs su mtho ris na yang bde ba rang mtshan pa med tshul bsam nas 'khor ba mtha' dag las nges par 'byung ba'i blo bskyed/ de nas rang nyams la dpag nas ma rgan sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba la sgrol 'dod kyi byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bskyed par byed dgos pas na chung 'bring dang thun mong pa'i blo sbyong ba chen po'i lam du 'khrid pa'i thabs mchog tu 'gyur ba yin pas so// gnyis pa snying bo len tshul dngos la gsum yod pa'i dang bo chung ngu dang thun mong ba'i lam la blo sbyong tshul ni blo nang du hril te bkug nas/

gal te mi lus rin po che rnyed dka' zhing rnyed na don che ba 'di 'dra thob 'dug ste 'di yun ring du mi gnas/ nges par 'chi/ de yang gang tsam na 'chi nges pa mi 'dug pas da lta nyid du snying bo len pa la 'bad dgos/ de yang de snga phan drag zhan 'bring gsum 'di tsam zhig khrom 'ur pa (88)bzhin du 'chi bdag gis bcom/ nga de snga phan ma shi ba de yang khar rje re chen snyam snying cha stong stong ba/ sa gcig tu sdod mi tshugs pa tsam gyi blo zhig bsnyed la/ rdor longs spyod gnyen nye ba su gang dang yang 'grog dbang med par de rnams kyi ched du bsags pa'i sdig pa de khyer nas 'gro dgos pa 'di 'dra ni ya cha snyam pa bya/ tshe 'di snang gi bza' dga' 'thung skyid/ mi nor zas gsum sogs gang song song song da ngas tshe lhag gang yod 'di la chos gsha' ma zhig byed/ de yang de ring nyid nas byed dgos snyam pa bya'o// 'o na 'chi ba'i tshe chos ma gtogs gang gis kyang mi phan na/ shi ba'i tshe chos kyis ji ltar phan/ chos min gyis ji ltar gnod snyam na/ nged rang shi nas kyang med par mi 'gro bar skye ba zhig ni blang dgos te skye ba yang bde 'gro dang ngan 'gro gang rung las ma 'das/ de yang las kyi dbang ma gtogs rang dbang ni med/ las dkar nag gis ji ltar 'phangs pa bzhin skye dgos la/ de yod pa'i tshe dge sems mngon du gyur na phyi ma bde 'gror skye/ de'i tshe mi dge ba'i sems mngon du gyur na phyi ma ngan 'gro gsum gang rung du skyes nas sdug bsngal drag po myong dgos/ ngan 'gro na sdug bsngal ji ltar yong na/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ rab tu tsha zhing grang ba yi// dmyal ba nyi ma gcig bzhin dran// bkres skom dag gi ring pa yi// yi dwags dag kyang dran par bya// rmongs pa'i sdug bsngal rab mang ba'i// byol song blta zhing dran par bya// de rgyu rnam spangs bde rgyu sbyang*// 'thob dka' 'dzam gling mi yi lus// de thob dus su ngan song rgyu// rab tu bsgrims te bcad par bya/

zhes gsungs pa ltar dmyal ba rnams la tsha grang gi sdug bsngal bzod par mi nus pa yod/ yi dwags rnams bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal bsran mi nus pa/ dud 'gro rnams la gcig (89)la gcig za glen lkugs sogs kyi sdug bsngal bzod par mi nus pa yod/ da lta me ma mur du lag pa bcug nas yud tsam sdod pa dang*/ dgun grang ba sgang la gos med par zhag gcig tsam sdod pa dang*/ zhag kha yar zas gang yang med par sdod pa dang*/ lus la sbrang bu sogs kyis so btab pa tsam yang bzod par dka' na tsha grang gi dmyal ba yi dgas dud 'gro gcig gis gcig gson por mid pa'i sdug bsngal sogs bdag gis ji ltar bzod snyam du da lta'i nyams la dpag nas shin tu 'jigs shing skrag pa'i yid kyi 'gyur ba ma thon bar du bsgom zhing*/ des na bdag gis dal ba'i rten bzang po thob pa'i dus 'dir ngan song gi rgyu spong ba dang bde 'gro'i rgyu la 'bad pa'i sgo nas ngan song du mi skye ba'i thabs la 'bad par bya'o snyam du bsgom/ 'o na ngan song du mi skye ba'i thabs la ji ltar 'bad snyam na gong du bshad pa ltar ngan song gi sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs pa dang*/ 'jigs pa de las skyob pa'i nus pa dkon mchog gsum la yod par shes nas dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la snying thag pa nas skyabs su 'gro bar bya la/ dkon mchog gsum gyis ngan song gi 'jigs pa las skyob nus pa yang yin te/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog de rang 'jigs pa thams cad las grol// gzhan 'jigs pa thams cad las skyob pa'i thabs la mkhas/ kun la thugs rje chen po nye ring med par 'jug /phan btags ma btags thams cad kyi don mdzad pas skyabs su 'os shing*/ des chos dang dge 'dun yang mtshan nus la// des na phyi rol ba'i ston pa dang chos dang dge 'dun la yon tan de dag gang yang med pas skyabs su mi 'os/ dkon mchog gsum la yon tan de ltar yod pas skyabs su 'gro bar 'os so// skyabs su ji ltar 'gro na/

rkang gnyis rnams kyi (90)mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// bdag 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal las sgrol ba'i ston pa mdzad du gsol/ 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog chos la skyabs su mchi'o// bdag 'khor ba dang ngan song gi 'jigs pa las sgrol ba'i skyabs dngos mdzad du gsol/ tshogs rnams kyi mchog dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// bdag 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal las sgrol ba'i grogs mdzad du gsol/ zhes snying thag pa nas blo lings blos bslangs te bkal ba'i skyabs 'gro bya/ de ltar skyabs su song nas bslab bya la ma bslabs na skyabs 'gro las nyams par 'gyur bas bslab bya la slob dgos/ de yang bdag sangs rgyas la skyabs su song na 'jig rten pa'i lha drag po khyab 'jug sogs la skyabs su mi 'dzin/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs la yang sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes byas te gus par bya/ bdag chos la skyabs su song nas sems can la 'tshe ba mi bya/ yi ge na gcig yan chad la ma gus pa spangs te gus par bya/ bdag dge 'dun dkon mchog la skyabs su song nas mu stegs sam sdig grogs dang 'grogs 'dris mi bya/ tha na ser ma gyon pa tsam la yang ma gus pa spangs te gus par bya'o// gzhan yang phan bde dge legs thams cad dkon mchog gi bka' drin du shes par byas te bza' btung gi phung sogs kyis dkon mchog la mchod pa dang*/ 'phral dang phug gi don thams cad dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba btab nas byed kyi phal pa'i mo bon sad sud la mi brten/ rang gi nus pa gang yod kyis sems can gzhan dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro ba la dgod/ srog gi phyir yang dkon mchog mi gtong zhing*/ de gtong pa'i tshig tsam yang ma shor ba byed dgos yang snyam par byas nas nyin lan gsum mtshan lan (91)gsum du bsams la/ yon tan shes pa/ khyad par shes pa/ khas blangs pa gzhan du mi smra ba'i sgo nas nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du bsam pa thag pa nas skyabs 'gro bya'o// 'o na dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song bas ngan song gi sdug bsngal las skyob nus mod/

mtho ris kyi 'jig rten ji lta bu sgrub snyam na/ de yang dkar nag gi las 'bras bsam ste dge sdig gi las so sor nges pa dang*/ 'phel che ba las ma byas pa dang mi 'phrad pa las byas pa chud mi za ba sogs kyi tshul bsam ste dge sdig gi blang dor tshul bzhin du byed dgos la/ de yang dngos stobs kyi rigs pas nges mi nus pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal bo las// zla ba skar mar bcas pa gnas lhung zhing*// ri dang grong dang bcas pa'i sa zhig la// nam mkha'i khams ni rnam pa gzhan gyur kyang*// khyod ni mi bden pa yi tshig mi gsung*/ zhes gsungs pa ltar sangs rgyas kyi gsung la zhe thag pa nas yid ches rnyed par byas nas// mi dge ba las sdug bsngal 'byung*// de las ji ltar nges thar zhes// nyin mtshan kun tu bdag gis ni// 'di nyid 'ba' zhig bsam pa'i rigs// zhes dang*// dge ba'i phyogs rnams thams cad kyi// rtsa ba mos par thub pas gsungs// de'i yang rtsa ba rtag tu ni// rnam smin 'bras bu sgom pa'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ spyir mi dge ba mtha' dag spangs/ khyad par sgo gsum gyi mi dge ba bcu che 'bring chung ngur spyod pa'i rnam smin ngan song du skye ba/ rgyu mthun dang bdag 'bras sogs yid du mi 'ong ba 'byin tshul bsams la/ bden pa po'i le'u las/ rgyal bo khyod ni srog gcod ma mdzad cig /skye bo kun la srog ni rab tu phongs// de bas yun ring tshe bsring su 'dod pa// yid kyis su la'ang srog (92)gcod mi bsam mo// zhes gsungs pa ltar srog gcod pa sogs kyi kha na ma tho ba rnams la kun slong tsam yang mi rgyu bar sdom sems mang du bsten/ srog gcod spong pa sogs dge ba mtha' dag la 'bad nas sgrub dgos ang*/ rje bla mas kyang*/ shi nas ngan 'gror mi skye'i gding med cing*// de yi 'jigs skyob dkon mchog gsum du nges// de phyir skyabs 'gro shin tu bsten pa dang*// de yi bslab bya nyams pa med par bya// de yang dkar nag las 'bras legs bsam ste// blang dor tshul bzhin sgrub la rag las so// zhes gsungs/

de yang mi dge bcu spong gi tshul khrims bsrungs pas rten bzang po rnyed mod kyang lam mchog rnam mkhyen sgrub pa la rigs mtho zhing gzugs bzang ba sogs kyi rnam smin gyi yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa zhig sgrub dgos pas de'i rgyu sems can gzhan la 'tshe ba spong ba/ mar me dang gos gsar pa sogs sbyin pa/ nga rgyal bcom nas gzhan la gus par bya ba sogs la dran shes bsten nas lag tu len dgos/ 'on kyang nyon mongs mang ba sogs kyis gal te sdig ltung gis gos na/ de ji mi snyam par mi 'jog par ltung ba rnams skabs dang bstun pa'i phyir bcos dang*/ sdig pa rnams stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas bshags par byas la/ sgo gsum sdig ltung gis ma gos pa la 'bad par bya dgos te/ rje bla mas kyang*/ lam mchog sgrub la mtshan nyid tshang ba'i rten// ma red par dus tshod mi 'ong pas// de yi ma tshang med pa'i rgyu la bslab// sgo gsum sdig ltung dri mas sbags pa 'di// lhag par las sgrib sbyong ba gnad che bas// rgyun du stobs bzhi tshang ba bsten pa gces/ zhes gsungs pas so// de ltar bsgoms pas tshe 'di la blo log ste tshe phyi ma'i phun tshogs don gnyer gyi (93)blo bcos min nam skyes pa na skyes bu chung ngu'i lam la blo sbyongs pa'i lag rjes byung ba yin no// gnyis pa skyes bu 'bring dang thun mong ba'i lam la blo sbyang ba ni/ de ltar mi dge bcu spangs shing dge bcu nyams su blangs pas mtho ris kyi rten khyad par can zhig 'thob mod kyang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las ma 'das pas/ des na sdug bsngal mtha' dag spangs pa'i thar ba zhig thob dgos so// 'o na 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin ji ltar yin snyam na/ ngan song gsum ni sngar bshad pa ltar yin la/ de yang skabs 'dir cung zad khyad par bton nas bsam dgos pa ni ngan song so so'i sdug bsngal bsam nas de'i rjes la/

'di lta bu'i sdug bsngal dar drag la rgyun ring ba 'di bdag gis bzod thabs mi 'dug pas 'dis mtshon pa'i 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal spangs pa'i thar ba ci nas kyang thob par bya snyam du bsam/ ngan song las gzhan pa'i 'khor ba mtho dman mtha' dag kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das te/ mi rnams la ni skye ba na ma'i mngal mun nag dri nga ba ljan ljin mang ba sogs kyis sdug bsngal zhing*/ skye ba na zhag bdun phrag so brgyad pa la sngon las kyi rang gis bdas te 'jur mig la 'dren pa'am/ til btsir ba ltar shin tu sdug bsngal ba dang*/ btsas nas kyang shin tu 'jam pa'i gdan la bzhag kyang tsher ma'i khrod du lhung ba lta bu'i sdug bsngal bzod thabs med pa nyams su myong bas na skye ba'i sdug bsngal de lta bu yod/ btsas nas lus lang tsho dar la bab par gyur ba ni rim pas sked pa ni gzhu ltar dgug /mgo bo ni spra ba'i me tog ltar dkar/ dpral ba ni gras stan ltar gnyer mas khengs/ sdod pa'i tshe skya thag chad pa lta bu/ ldang ba'i tshe shing cha gnam du 'don pa 'dra ba/ smra ni lce rdib// (94)'gro na lus 'bub 'khyor/ mig rna sogs kyis yul gsal bar mi mthong*/ lus kyi mdangs nyams pa ni ro lta bu/ dran pa nyams pas brjed nges che/ bza' btung sogs 'ju dka' zhing ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin longs spyod mi nus/ tshe phal cher zad pas 'chi ba la myur du phyogs pa'i rga ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/ lus kyi 'byung ba cha ma snyoms par 'khrugs te na ba'i tshe phyi'i pags pa skam/ nang gi sha zhu/ bza' btung yid du 'ong ba rnams nang la phog dog pa spang dgos// yid du mi 'ong ba'i bza' btung sman la sogs pa mi 'dod bzhin bstan dgos/ gtar sreg sogs kyi dpyad rtsub mo rnams bsten dgos/ nad mi 'tsho bar dogs nas sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa myong dgos pa na ba'i sdug bsngal/ 'chi nges ba'i nad drag pos thebs na 'chi bar shes/

sngar byas kyi las ngan rnams la ni 'gyod mi tshe stong zad du song ba ni dran/ lus longs spyod gnyen bshes 'khor g.yog rnams 'bral ba ni shes/ kha ni bskams/ mchu ni brdzes// sna ni zhom/ mig ni kong dmar por song*/ dbugs ni brtsegs/ ngan song gi sdug bsngal drag pos ni 'jigs/ mi 'dod bzhin du 'chi dgos pa'i sdug bsngal/ res 'ga' chom rkun sogs dgra mi sdug pa dang phrad nas zas nor thams cad bcom/ lus la mtshon dang dbyug pa sogs kyis bsnun/ res rgyal po sogs kyi chad las mi 'dra ba sna tshogs kyis mnar ba dang*/ yang na gtam ngan thos pa sogs kyi mi sdug pa dang phrad pa'i sdug bsngal/ zas nor sogs bde sdug gtam ngan khyad du bsad nas bsgrubs pa rnams dang snying nye ba sogs yid du 'ong ba dang mi 'dod bzhin du 'bral ba'i sdug bsngal/ 'dod pa btsal yang ma rnyed pa'i sdug bsngal ni khyim pa lta bu la zhing las la 'bad kyang than pa sad (95)ser sogs kyis lo tog 'dod pa bzhin ma grub pa/ gru gcod pa'i tshe rlung la sogs pas ma rungs par gyur pa/ tshong pa yin na tshong zong brlag pa khe spogs ma byung ba sogs dang*/ rab byung rnams la ni khas blangs pa'i tshul khrims mgo ma thon pa sogs gang re ba de ma thob pa'i sdug bsngal/ nyer len gyi phung po 'di blangs tsam gyis tshe 'dir na rga 'chi ba sogs sdug bsngal gyi rten byed/ tshe phyi ma'i sdug bsngal rnams 'dren par byed/ sdug bsngal dang 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal gnyis kyi snod du gyur ba dang*/ ngo bo khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin pas sdug bsngal ba'i rang bzhin ma gtogs bde ba'i rang bzhin cung zad kyang mi 'dug go// lha min ni lus bcad dral sogs kyi sdug bsngal shin tu rtsub pa las ma 'das/ 'dod lha rnams la ni 'chi ltas lngas zin pa na dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal las ches che ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/

spa bkong ba dang*/ gnas nas skrod pa sogs sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa yong*// khams gong ma'i lha so skyel sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal mngon gyur med kyang*/ bsam gtan gsum pa man chad la 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/ bsam gtan bzhi pa dang gzugs med khams su ni khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal phol mig kun nas tsha ba lta bu'i sdug bsngal las ma 'das 'dug pas 'khor ba spyi bye brag gi sdug bsngal 'di rnams spangs pa'i thar ba'i go 'phang ci nas kyang thob par byed dgos so// de yang rgyu med rkyen med du mi 'thob pas thar ba thob byed kyi thabs bslab pa gsum la tshul bzhin du bslab par bya dgos/ de yang bslab pa gzhan gnyis kyi gzhi rten med mi rung lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa la bslab dgos/ de yang mi shes pa sogs ltung ba 'byung ba'i rgyu rnams la dran shes kyi legs (96)par brtags nas dang por ltung ba mi 'byung ba zhig byed/ gal te byung yang ltung ba dang rgyun ring du mi 'grogs par bshags sdom tshul bzhin du byed dgos/ des na nyon mongs pa gang che ba de'i gnyen po 'bad nas bsgoms te ltung bas ma gos par byed cing las dang bya ba ci byed kyang ston pa'i bka' dang mi 'gal bar rang la mi khrel ba zhig byed dgos ang*/ rje bla mas kyang*// sdug bden nyes dmigs bsam la ma 'bad na// thar ba don gnyer ji bzhin mi skyo zhing*// kun 'byung 'khor ba'i 'jug rim ma bsam na// 'khor ba'i rtsa ba gcod tshul mi shes pas// srid las nges 'byung skyo shas bsten pa dang*// 'khor bar gang gis bcings pa shes pa gces/ zhes gsungs gda'o// des na 'khor ba mtha' dag la me 'bar ba'i khyim du tshud pa'i mi zhig khyim de las thar 'dod yod pa lta bu'i 'khor ba las blo log pa'i blo skyes pa na skyes bu 'bring gi lam la blo sbyangs pa'i lag rjes byung ba yin no// gsum pa skyes bu chen po'i lam la blo sbyong ba ni/

de ltar lam bslab pa gsum nyams su blangs pas thar ba'i go 'phang tsam thob kyang*/ de tsam gyis mi chog ste/ thar ba tsam thob phyin chad 'khor bar 'khyams mi dgos kyang skyon phyogs re tsam spangs pa dang yon tan phyogs re rdzogs pa yin pas rang don mthar phyin ma thob/ de'i gnad kyis gzhan don yang nyi tshe ba las mi 'grub/ des na don gnyis mthar phyin gyi sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang zhig thob par byed dgos par 'dug go// sangs rgyas de yang rang nyid rkyang pa'i phyir min gyi/ sems can thams cad kyi phyir don du gnyer ba zhig dgos te/ rang sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor lhung ba bzhin du sems can rnams kyang sdug bsngal gyis mnar bas nyam thag pa sha stag yin zhing*/ sems can rnams rang gi pha mar ma gyur ba gcig kyang med/ (97)de yang lan grangs dpag tu med par byas shing drin gyis bskyangs pa'i drin can 'ba' zhig yin pas drin can de rnams sdug bsngal las bsgral te/ mi gnas pa'i myang 'das bla na med pa'i go 'phang la dgod pa'i phyir du byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed par bya'o// de yang rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun gyi sgo nas sems bskyed dgos te/ rgyu 'bras bdun yang sems can thams can mar shes pa las de thams cad kyi drin dran pa 'byung*/ de las drin gzo/ de las yid 'ong gi blo/ de las lhag bsam 'dren nus pa'i byams pa dang snying rje/ de las lhag bsam rnam dag /de las byang chub kyi sems/ de las rnams mkhyen 'byung ba'i phrugs bdun yod la/ de dag gi sngon du yang sems can thams cad la sems snyoms pa'i gtang snyoms sgom dgos te/ sems can rnams la nye ring bar ma phyogs su ltung ba yod na sems can rnams la mar shes kyi blo mtshan nyid tshang ba mi skye/ byams snying rje cung zad skye ba yang phyogs ris can du 'gro// des na thog mar btang snyoms sgom dgos// de'i tshul yang tshe 'dir phan gnod gang yang ma byas pa'i bar ma'i sems can du ma la dmigs nas/

'di dag gi ngos nas bde ba 'dod sdug bsngal mi 'dod par yang mtshungs shing*/ rang gi ngos nas 'di rnams rang gi pha ma byas pa'i gnyen sha stag yin pas 'ga' re nye bar bzung phan 'dogs 'ga' re ring bar bzung nas gnod pa skyel ba'i cha gnyis mi bya bar 'di thams cad la sems mnyam par bya'o snyam du bsgom/ de nas tshe 'di'i gnyen nye ba rnams dang*/ de nas tshe 'dir gnod pa byas pa'i sems can rnams la'ang mnyam par bya/ de las sems can thams cad la sems snyoms pa'i btang snyoms bskyed par bya'o// de skyes pa dang 'khor ba la thog mtha' med pas na bdag (98)gi skye ba la'ang thog mtha' med/ de'i gnad kyis gnas 'di lta bur ma skyes zhes bya ba'am/ sems can 'di 'dra zhig gis bdag gis ma byas zhes bya ba gcig kyang med/ byas pa la grangs kyis kyang mi chod/ des na skye shi 'phos pas ngo ma shes pa ma gtogs sems can gyi khams na rang gi pha mar ma gyur pa gcig kyang med/ pha mar gyur res kyi tshe 'di'i ma dang 'dra bar drin gyis bskyangs pa'i drin can sha stag yin/ tshe 'di'i mas drin gyis ji ltar bskyangs na/ bdag gi da lta'i ma 'dis mngal du yod ba'i tshe bdag la gnod kyis dogs g.yor bzo ba sogs kyis bskyangs/ btsas nas ni 'jam pa'i gos stan la bzhag /sor mo bcu'i kha la blangs/ byams pa'i mig gis bltas/ dga' ba'i 'dzum gyis bsus/ brtse bas nu zho bsnan/ sha'i drod la bcar/ zas lces bsnyod/ snabs khas phyis/ mi gtsang ba lag pas phyis/ ma rang nyid srog la thug pa bas kyang bu dag cung zad na ba sdug par byas/ dka' las skyid sdug thams cad khyad du bsad nas bsgrubs pa'i nor dngos po rang gis bed gcod ma nus pa rnams bdag la sbyin/ mdor na ma rang gi 'khos dang bstun ba'i gnod 'tshe las bskyabs/ phan btags pa'i drin can yin snyam pa'i blo brtse yam yam pa bya/ de nas tshe 'di'i pha la sogs pa'i gnyen nye ba rnams dang*/

de nas bar ma rnams dang*/ de nas tshe 'dir gnod pa bskyal ba'i sems can la dmigs nas 'di rnams kyis bdag gi ma byas pa grangs kyis mi chod/ de yang mi'i rten la ma byas pa grangs kyis mi chod cing*/ ma nam byas res kyi tshe 'di'i ma bzhin du gnod pa las bskyabs/ phan tshad med pa btags pa'i drin can yin no// de ltar lan grangs tshad med par drin gyis bskyongs pa'i ma rnams nyon mongs pa'i gdon gyis sems dkrugs pas de dag (99)rang dbang med par smyo// gti mug gis shes rab mig ldongs pas mngon mtho nges legs kyi lam blta ba'i mig dang ni bral/ thar ba'i grong du 'khrid pa'i bshes gnyen gyi long 'khrid pa ni med/ skad cig re re zhing nyes spyod kyis dbyen bcos nas gom 'gros 'khyor ba dang ngan song gi g.yang sa nyam nga ba la 'grim pas sdug bsngal zhing nyam thag pa 'di rnams bu bdag la mi re na su la re/ ma de sdug bsngal las sgrol ba yang bdag la mi 'bab na su la 'bab/ drin can gyi ma rnams yal bar dor nas rang gcig pu 'khor ba las ci thar byed na de las/ khrel dang ngo tsha che ba mi 'ong*/ des na ma rnams kyis 'khor ba'i bde 'bras tshangs pa dang brgya byin sogs ji snyed cig thob kyang rtag ma thub/ de bdag gis rang yal bar dor nas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las bsgral te thar ba bla na med pa'i bde ba la ci nas kyang dgod par bya'o// des na bde bas phongs pa'i ma rgan 'di rnams thams cad bde ba dang phrad na ci ma rung*/ bde ba dang phrad par gyur cig /ci nas kyang bde ba dang phrad par bya'o// sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i ma rgan sems can 'di thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral na ci ma rung*/ sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang bral bar bya'o// de yang bdag gis bya'o// 'o na de'i nus pa khyod la yod dam snyam na/ de lta na bdag la sems can thams cad lta zhog sems can gcig tsam yang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las bsgral nas bde ba bla na med pa la 'god pa'i nus pa mi 'dug

/de ltar dam bca' zhig ni byas/ da dam bca' de yal bar dor na ngan song du ltung bar 'gyur bas// des na sems can thams cad sdug bsngal (100)las sgrol ba dang bde ba bla na med pa la 'god nus pa sangs rgyas ma gtogs gzhan na mi 'dug pas bdag gis sems can thams cad sdug bsngal mtha' dag las bskyab nas bla na med pa'i bde ba la 'god pa'i don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ci nas kyang thob par bya'o snyam du bsam/ de ltar smon pa tsam gyis mi chog pas bsam pa sems bskyed de tshe 'dir mi nyams pa'i byang sems bskyed la spro shugs 'phel ba'i phyir du phan yon bsam pa la bslab pa/ sems bskyed dngos 'phel ba'i phyir du lan drug tu bskyed pa la bslab pa/ gang gi don du sems bskyed pa'i sems can blos mi spong ba la bslab pa/ tshogs bsags pa bslab pa dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa tsam gyis lha mi thams cad kyis mchod pa'i gnas su 'gyur/ nyan rang dgra bcom rnams kyang rigs kyi sgo nas zil gyis gnon/ rim pa la sogs pa'i nad dang gdon gyis mi tshugs shing*/ zhi sogs kyi las tshogs rnams kyang tshegs med du 'grub/ ngan song la sogs par mi skye/ skyes kyang myur du thar/ sdig pa stobs can shin tu mi bzad pa yang myur du 'joms/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i phan yon gzugs su grub na ni nam mkhar mi shong bar bshad pas sems 'di mi nyams par gong 'phel du byed dgos snyam du bsam/ gnyis pa ni/ bdag gis byang chub kyi sems 'di bar ma dor btang na phas pham las kyang rnam smin lci bas sangs rgyas ma thob bar mi gtong zhing*/ nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa 'di dag gis// 'gro la phan phyir (101)sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/ces pa lan gsum gsum gyis sems bskyed par bya'o// gsum pa ni/ bdag gis sems can gyi don du byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa yin pas sems can gyi ngos nas mi 'dra ba ci byung yang bdag rang gi ngos nas sems can thams cad nam du'ang blos mi spang snyam par bya'o// bzhi pa ni/ byang chub kyi sems lan cig bskyed pa 'di mi nyams shing gong du 'phel ba'i phyir du dkon mchog mchod pa sogs tshogs rgya chen po la bslab par bya'o// skye ba gzhan du yang byang chub kyi sems de dang mi 'bral ba'i rgyur ni nag po'i chos bzhi spong ba dang*/ dkar po'i chos bzhi bsten pa la bslab dgos pa'i/ nag po'i chos bzhi ni/ dang po mkhan po dang bla ma sogs yon gnas gang yang rung ba la rdzun gyis dbu skor thabs byed pa nag chos yin pas de 'dra gtan mi bya zhing de'i gnyen por sems can su la'ang srog gam bzhad gad kyi phyir yang rdzun mi smra// nag chos gnyis pa gzhan dge ba bsgrubs nas mi 'gyod pa la 'gyod du gzhug pa ste/ de lta bu gtan nas mi bya zhing*/ de'i gnyen por rang gis smin par bya ba'i gdul bya snod du rung na theg dman la mi dgod par theg chen la dgod par bya'o// nag chos gsum pa theg pa chen por sems bskyed pa'i gang zag la zhe sdang gis mi snyan pa brjod pa ste/ de 'dra gtan mi bya zhing de'i gnyen por theg chen gyi gang zag la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed/ skabs su bab na don la gnas pa'i bsngags pa brjod cing sems can thams cad la yang dag snang sbyang bar bya'o// nag chos bzhi pa ni sems can la g.yo sgyus spyod par byed pa ste/ de 'dra nam yang mi bya zhing sems can rnams la drang po'i bsam pa bya'o// rje bla mas kyang*/ sems bskyed theg chen (102)lam gyi gzhung shing ste// rlabs chen spyod pa rnams kyi gzhi dang rten// tshogs gnyis kun la gser 'gyur rtsi lta bu// rab 'byams dge tshogs sdud ba'i bsod nams gter// de ltar shes nas rgyal sras dpa' bo rnams// rin chen sems mchog thugs dam mthil du 'dzin/

zhes gsungs/ 'o na smon sems la bslab pa tsam gyis chog gam snyam na/ de tsam gyis mi chog /de'i steng du 'jug sdom blangs nas rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rlabs po che la bslab dgos shing*/ de yang rang rgyud smin byed phar phyin drug dang*/ gzhan rgyud smin byed pa bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la bslab dgos pa'i dang bo la drug yod pa las sbyin pa la bslab tshul ni sems can thams cad kyi phyir du sangs rgyas thob par bya'o snyam pa'i bsam pa des kun nas bslangs te dam pa'i chos kyis phongs pa thams cad la dam pa'i chos phyin ci ma log pa bstan/ rgyal bo dang dmag la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa dang*/ 'dre gcan gzan sbrul la sogs pa'i sems yod kyi 'jigs pa dang*/ me chu sogs sems med kyi 'jigs pa rnams las bskyabs/ bza' btung mal stan na ba'i gsos sman sogs nor gyis phongs pa rnams la de dag phongs med du sbyin/ mdor na lus longs spyod dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge rtsa thams cad phongs med du gtong ngo*/ de ltar yang rje bla mas/ sbyin pa 'gro ba'i re skong yid bzhin nor// ser sna'i mdud pa gcod pa'i mtshon cha mchog /ma zhum snying stobs skyed pa'i rgyal sras spyod// snyan pa'i grags pa phyogs bcur sgrog pa'i gzhi// de ltar shes rab lus dang longs spyod dge// yongs su gtong ba'i lam bzang mkhas pas bsten/ zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa tshul khrims la bslab tshul ni/ sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i phyir du dran shes bzhin ngo tsha khrel (103)yod kyi bsam pa nor byas la mi dge ba srog la bab kyang mi bya zhing*/ de ltar nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims de la brten nas phar phyin drug gong 'phel du byed dgos// de gnyis la brten nas sems can gyi don la kha na ma tho ba med par bsgrubs te tshul khrims gsum la bslab par bya ste/ rje bla mas/ tshul khrims nyes spyod dri ma 'khrud pa'i chu// nyon mongs tsha gdung sel ba zla ba'i 'od// skye rgu'i dbus na lhun po lta bur brjid// stobs kyis bsdigs pa med par 'gro kun 'dud// de ltar shes nas yang dag bslabs pa'i khrims// dam pa rnams kyis mig bzhin bsrung bar mdzod/

ces gdams/ bzod pa la bslab tshul la/ gzhan gyis rang la gnod pa byas pa la khro bar mi 'os te/ gzhan gyis gnod pa byas pa de sngar rang gis kho la gnod pa bskyal ba'i le lan yin zhing*/ kho rang la'ang khong khros rang dbang med par byas pa yin pas gnod lan byed mi rung*/ khong khro skad cig gis kyang bskal pa mang por bsags pa'i gzhi gsum gyi dge rtsa rnams 'joms par 'dug pas bdag gis khong khro'i bsam pa yid kyi dgu la'ang mi bya ang snyam pa gnod pa la ji mi snyam pa'i bzod pa dang*/ gzhan gyis bdag la gnod pa byas nas sdug bsngal drag po myong bas ni nga rgyal dang dregs pa sogs sel/ 'khor ba las nges par 'byung ba'i blo skye/ sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa byang ba na/ de mi dge ba las byung ba yin pas rgyu med na 'bras bu ga la 'byung snyam du mi dge ba la blo mi 'jug /gzhan gyis gnod pa byas pa la bzod pa bsams pas phyin drug gzhan rnams kyang rdzogs nas 'tshang rgya bas gnod byed pa bzod pa bsgom pa'i gdams ngag ster ba'i bla ma lta bur mthong nas drin che ba'i blo skyed pa sdug bsngal dang len gyi bzod pa dang*/ dkon mchog (104)gsum dang sangs rgyas byang sems kyi mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa mthong ste rgyal sras kyi spyod pa dang bdag med pa'i don la mos pa'i sgo nas de rnams la slob 'dod chos la nges sems kyi bzod pa ste bzod pa'i nyams len zhe thag pa nas byed dgos te// rje bla mas/ bzod pa stobs ldan rnams la rgyan gyi mchog /nyon mongs gdung ba'i dka' thub kun gyi phul// zhe sdang lag 'gro'i dgra la nam mkha' lding*// tshig rtsub mtshon la sra ba'i go cha yin// de ltar shes nas bzod mchog go cha la// rnam pa sna tshogs tshul gyis goms par mdzod/ ces gsungs so// bzhi pa brtson 'grus la bslab tshul ni/ sgo gsum gyi snyoms las ngang 'khrig pa dang gnyid kyi bde ba sogs bde ba dman pa la sred pas 'khor ba la skye ba ma bsgoms pa las le lo skye bas le lo'i rgyu de rnams spangs te lus ngag yid gsum dge ba'i bya ba 'ba' zhig gis 'khol dgos/

de yang sems can gcig tsam gyi sdug bsngal sel ba'i phyir du yang dka' spyad lus srog la mig lta snyam pa go cha'i brtson 'grus/ de la brten nas phar phyin drug nyams len gong 'phel du byed pa dge ba chos sdud kyi brtson 'grus/ de gnyis kyi sgo nas kha na ma tho ba med pas sems can gyi don 'bad nas byed pa sems can don byed kyi brtson 'grus la 'bad dgos te/ rje bla mas/ mi ldog brtan pa'i brtson 'grus go bgos na// lung rtogs yon tan yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel// spyod lam thams cad don dang ldan par 'gyur// gang brtsams las kyi mtha' rnams yid bzhin 'grub/ de ltar shes nas le lo kun sel ba'i// rlabs chen brtson 'grus rgyal sras rnams kyis brtsam/ zhes gsungs so// lnga pa bsam gtan la bslab tshul ni/ sems bskyed kyis kun nas bslangs te 'jig (105)rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bsam gtan gnyis dang*/ phyogs kyi dbye bas zhi gnas dang lhag mthong zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi bsam gtan gsum dang*/ byed las kyi sgo nas mthong chos tshe 'di la lus sems bde bar gnas pa'i bsam gtan/ mngon shes la sogs yon tan gong ma mngon par sgrub pa'i bsam gtan/ sems can gyi don sgrub pa'i bsam gtan dang gsum ste/ de rnams la bying rgod dang bral bar bslab par bya dgos te/ rje bla mas/ bsam gtan sems la dbang sgyur rgyal bo ste// gzhag na g.yo med ri yi dbang bo bzhin// btang na dge ba'i dmigs pa kun la 'jug /lus sems las su rung ba'i bde chen 'dren// de ltar shes nas rnal 'byor dbang bo rnams// nam g.yeng dgra 'joms ting 'dzin rgyun du bsten/ zhes gsungs/ drug pa shes rab la bslab tshul ni/ sems bskyed kyis kun nas bslangs te/ srid pa'i rtsa ba drung nas 'byin byed de kho na nyid kyi don rtogs pa don dam rtogs pa'i shes rab dang*/ kun rdzob rtogs pa'i shes rab dang*/

de gnyis kyis sems can gyi don byed pa'i shes rab rnams la bslab par bya dgos te/ rje bla mas/ shes rab zab mo'i de nyid lta ba'i mig /srid pa'i rtsa ba drung nas 'byin pa'i lam// gsung rab kun las bsngags pa'i yon tan gter// gti mug mun sel sgron me mchog tu grags// de ltar shes nas thar 'dod mkhas pa yis// lam de 'bad pa du mas bskyed par mdzad// ces gsungs so// gnyis pa gzhan rgyud smin byed bsdu ba bzhi la bslab tshul ni/ sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya snyam pa'i bsam pa des kun nas bslangs te thog mar zang zing gi sbyin pas sems can rnams 'khor du bsdus/ de (106)nas sems can rnams dga' ba'i phyir du bzhin mdangs gsal ba sngon du btang ste phebs par smra bas bag phab/ de nas phar phyin drug gi gtam la sogs pa chos snyan par smra ba dang*/ de nas chos bstan pa ltar don nyams su len du 'jug pa'i don spyod pa dang*/ de nas gzhan ji ltar nyams su len du bcug pa ltar rang nyid kyang phar phyin drug nyams su lan pa'i don mthun pa ste/ gzhan don sgrub pa'i thabs zab mo 'di rnams la ci nas kyang bslab par bya la/ des na bdag 'dzin 'khor ba'i rtsa ba yin pas de dang 'dzin stangs dngos su 'gal ba'i lam sgom pa med par rtse gcig pa'i bsam gtan tsam gyis 'khor ba'i rtsa ba gcod mi nus shing dmigs pa las mi g.yo bar rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i zhi gnas med par bden med rtogs pa'i shes rab tsam gyis ji tsam dpyad kyang nyon mongs zlog mi nus te/ nyon mongs spangs pa'i thar ba thob pa la stong ba nyid kyi don phyin ci ma log pa'i yin lugs phu thag chod par rtogs pa'i lta ba de dmigs pa la g.yo ba med pa'i zhi gnas kyi rta la bskyon nas rtag chad kyi mtha' dang bral ba'i dbu ma'i rig pa gtan tshigs chen po bzhi'i mtshon rnon po mthar 'dzin gyi dmigs gtad thams cad 'jig par byed pa'i de kho na nyid kyi don la tshul bzhin du spyod pa'i shes rab kyis de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i blo gros rgyas par mdzad dgos pa'i phyir// rje bla mas/

rtse gcig bsam gtan tsam la 'khor ba yi// rtsa ba gcod pa'i nus pa ma mthong zhing*// zhi gnas lam dang bral ba'i shes rab kyis// ji tsam dpyad kyang nyon mongs mi zlog pas// yin lugs phu thag chod pa'i shes rab de// g.yo med zhi gnas rta la bskyon nas ni// mtha' bral dbu ma'i dmigs pa'i mtshon rnon gyis// mthar 'dzin dmigs gtad thams cad 'jig byed pa/ (107)tshul bzhin dpyod pa'i yangs pa'i shes rab kyis// de nyid rtogs pa'i blo gros rgyas par mdzad// ces gsungs/ de nas dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu g.yo ba med par 'jog pa las zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin 'grub par ma zad/ rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa'i ngang nas de kho na nyid kyi don la tshul bzhin du dpyod pa'i so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis dpyad pas kyang yin lugs stong ba nyid kyi don la g.yo ba med par shin tu brtan pa'i ting nge 'dzin bskyed par mthong nas zhi lhag zung du 'brel ba sgrub pa la brtson pa ya mtshan pa yin no snyam du smon lam gyi yul du byas nas bag chags 'jog pa la 'bad de/ rje bla mas/ rtse gcig bsgoms pas ting 'dzin 'grub par ni// smos par ci 'tshal tshul bzhin dpyod pa yi// so sor rtog pa yis kyang yin lugs la// g.yo med shin tu brtan par gnas pa yi// ting 'dzin bskyed par mthong nas zhi lhag gnyis// zung 'brel sgrub la'ang brtson rnams ya mtshan no// zhes gsungs/ de lta bu'i zhi lhag zung 'brel la mnyam par bzhag pa'i nam mkha' lta bu spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i stong nyid la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag nas de las langs pa'i rjes thob tu rang bzhin gyis ma grub kyang de ltar snang ba'i sgyu ma lta bu'i stong pa nyid bsgoms nas snying rje dang byang chub kyi sems kyis zin pa'i thabs shes zung du 'brel ba'i nyams len gyis rgyal sras kyi spyod pa'i pha rol tu 'gro ba ni shin tu bsngags par 'os la/

de ltar rtogs nas thabs shes ya bral ba'i lam phyogs re bas tshim pa med par thabs shes zung 'brel gyi lam la rtog pa skal bzang rnams kyi lugs yin pas de ltar 'bad dgos te/ rje bla mas/ mnyam bzhag
